reasons: Formula query1 (nginx.connections.active) is translated as avg(...) minus sum(state="waiting"); it should be a plain sum of the state="active" series with no subtraction.

Formula query2 (nginx.connections.idle) is translated as sum(state="waiting"); the Datadog metric is idle connections, and "waiting" is not in the Datadog source. The PromQL needs the idle state value, which must be verified against the observed dataset values for state.
The Datadog request has two displayed formulas, so two series are expected. The candidate's first formula combines both metrics into one expression, which changes the series set.
The template variable $host (tag prefix host, default *) must become a host matcher such as host=~"$host". Neither PromQL string includes it.
The outcome is translated, which is correct because an OTel metric measures the same quantity (nginx.connections_current with a state attribute), so the translated outcome is not the problem.
